headline: Phoenix Financial Posts NIS 2.1B Income, Announces Share Buybacks and Dividends
summary: Phoenix Financial reported comprehensive income totaling NIS 2.1 billion for the first nine months of 2026. The firm announced it is distributing NIS 1.65 billion in total year-to-date dividends and share buybacks, including a NIS 300 million third-quarter dividend.
why: Phoenix is a prominent financial services and insurance group operating in Israel, returning capital to equity holders through regular distributions.

impacts.name: Phoenix Holdings Ltd.
impacts.why: Strong nine-month income figures and substantial dividend distributions signal robust financial health for shareholders.
